context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Categorize Template Differences by Risk Level.

checklist.name: Risk categories defined
checklist.description: risk-assessment.md defines or lists at least 4 risk categories (Expected, Low, Medium, High, Critical or similar)

checklist.name: GitRef as expected
checklist.description: The GitRef tag change is categorized as Expected or Low risk (environment-specific metadata)

checklist.name: Alarm threshold as medium
checklist.description: The alarm threshold change is categorized as Medium risk (requires review)

checklist.name: IAM policy as high risk
checklist.description: The IAM policy modification is categorized as High risk (requires explicit sign-off)

checklist.name: CDK Nag suppression as critical
checklist.description: The new CDK Nag suppression is categorized as Critical or High risk (security override)

checklist.name: Resource changes assessed
checklist.description: The added CloudWatch alarms and removed S3 lifecycle policy are categorized with risk levels

checklist.name: Deployment decision present
checklist.description: Document includes a clear deployment decision (approve, review, sign-off, or block)

checklist.name: Decision matches risk
checklist.description: The deployment decision is appropriate for the risk levels found (should require sign-off or block due to IAM/CDK Nag changes)

checklist.name: Required actions listed
checklist.description: Document lists specific actions required before deployment (e.g., InfoSec approval, stakeholder review)

checklist.name: Avoids: Fewer than 4 risk categories are defined...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Fewer than 4 risk categories are defined or referenced

checklist.name: Avoids: GitRef tag change is categorized as Medium...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: GitRef tag change is categorized as Medium or higher risk

checklist.name: Avoids: Alarm threshold change is categorized as Low...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Alarm threshold change is categorized as Low or Expected risk (under-assessed) or Critical (over-assessed)

checklist.name: Avoids: IAM policy modification is not categorized as...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: IAM policy modification is not categorized as High risk

checklist.name: Avoids: CDK Nag suppression is not categorized as...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: CDK Nag suppression is not categorized as Critical or High risk

checklist.name: Avoids: Added/removed resources are not given risk level...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Added/removed resources are not given risk level assessments

checklist.name: Avoids: No deployment decision is provided
checklist.description: Failure avoided: No deployment decision is provided

checklist.name: Avoids: Deployment decision is Auto-approve or simple Approve...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Deployment decision is Auto-approve or simple Approve despite IAM and CDK Nag changes present

checklist.name: Avoids: No required actions are listed before deployment
checklist.description: Failure avoided: No required actions are listed before deployment
